acceptanceCriteria: CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP.md states the K1 outcome with a link to the V1-1266 build log
body: Found by the V1-1266 lane (PR #1286, head 6e7387505). docs/CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP.md:70 still lists the K1 kill criterion for hunk-revert held verdicts as pending. V1-1266 measured it: 0 held of 3,790 hunks over 350 maps after #944 (build log 2026-10-20-V1-1266-hunk-revert-falsifier.md). Expected: the map doc states the K1 outcome and links the build log.
title: docs: CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP.md lists K1 without its measured kill outcome
